t63c_p10k: A guru who demands surrender points you at themselves instead (so, more or less, they'd like to be your God). And sometimes they never have to ask. Ever met someone who seemed to get you better than you get yourself, and gave you more attention than you'd ever had? Your little one might just hand itself over, on its own.
t63c_p10l: Some gurus really do demand surrender, and they're the opposite of the Guide: they point you at themselves (so, more or less, they'd like to be your God). And sometimes they never have to ask. Somebody seems to get your little one better than anyone ever has, or gives it the attention it's been starving for, and it hands itself right over.
t63c_p10o: A guru who demands surrender points you at themselves instead (so, more or less, they'd like to be your God). Sometimes they never have to ask.
